newsitem.title: FRANCE: French GAN shares to retrade on Friday. [CORRECTED 12:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: French GAN shares to retrade on Friday. [CORRECTED 12:35 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects day for resumption of trading from Monday to Friday.)
Share trading in French state insurer GAN and units UIC and Sofal will resume on Friday at usual stock market opening time, 0900 GMT, the SBF stock markets association said on Thursday.

Trading in the shares was suspended earlier on Thursday pending statements from GAN and a finance ministry news conference set for 1630 GMT, following talks on a state aid package for loss-making GAN.
The board of GAN meets on Thursday afternoon and a statement is expected following the meeting.
Finance Minister Jean Arthuis is expected to reveal how much the government will commit to sorting out GAN's problems and analysts say the bill could reach 20 billion francs.
